clips.title: The story
paras: The Verdant Note is a formal summons delivered to promising young tauren in the Red Cloud Mesa. Entrusted by Grull Hawkwind, the message bids budding protectors of the wilds to seek out the druidic mentor Gart Mistrunner at Camp Narache.

Young tauren stepping into their responsibilities on the Red Cloud Mesa are quickly singled out for their natural gifts. Grull Hawkwind passes along this missive on behalf of a messenger sent by Gart Mistrunner. The note acts as an invitation into the ancient fold of tauren druidism, calling the initiate away from basic village errands to heed the whispering balance of the plains.

Upon answering the summons, Gart Mistrunner warns the fledgling druid that ancestral and natural spirits have grown restless across Mulgore. Tauren druids are tasked to act as living avatars of nature, keeping harmony with the will of the Earthmother regardless of distant rivalries. While night elves also practice druidic arts, Gart cautions that their pride blinds them to the tauren's own deep-seated bond with the natural realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, friend. I believe she was sent by the druid trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.
Return to me often, friend. You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.
